title: Pipeline
instructions:
This workbench runs one pipeline, and a card walks it once. It enters at
Intake, moves through the work columns once each, and ends at Done or at
Returned; nothing here is a place where work waits between stations.

Only Intake admits a new fact. A card arriving here carries everything the
pipeline will use: the material to work from, and where it came from. No
column after Intake adds a claim, a source, or an instruction from outside
the card; every later stage works from what the card already carries and
adds its own attachment to it.

Each work column reads the card in a context nobody has primed. Whoever
claims a card here reads the workbench's own rules, that column's own
instructions, and the card's attachments in the order they were added, and
nothing else about the card. None of an earlier stage's reasoning travels
forward, because a stage that inherited the thinking behind an attachment
could not judge that attachment on its own terms.

The artefact chain is the record. Each column reads the attachment the
column before it produced and adds its own, so a card finished at Done
carries the whole run in order.

The operator has no station inside this pipeline. Nobody here claims a
card, moves one, or settles an item in the operator's name, and no column
belongs to the operator. A decision the operator needs to make is made
before a card reaches Intake, or after it leaves at Done or at Returned.

Returned means a column needed a fact, a decision, or the operator that
this pipeline cannot supply on its own. The stage that sends a card to
Returned files the reason and a pointer back to this card, with everything
it carries, on the workbench that owns the work the pipeline was run for,
and this card is not reopened afterward. When what was missing is settled
there, a fresh card starts the pipeline again.

columns.title: Intake
columns.instructions:
A card arrives here holding what the rest of the pipeline needs to act on,
and where each part of it came from. Nothing is researched or decided at
this column. A card whose material is missing, or whose source is not
named, does not belong at Intake; move it to Returned instead, naming what
is missing, rather than letting Draft discover the gap.

Nobody claims a card here. Pull a ready card into Draft with
`dinah pull draft`.

columns.title: Draft
columns.instructions:
You hold this card in a context nobody has primed with the reasoning
behind it. Read the workbench's own instructions, this column's
instructions, and the card's attachments in the order they were added,
and use nothing else.

Produce the first version of what this pipeline is building, working only
from the card and its attachments, and attach it. Where the card is
missing a fact, a source, or a decision it should have carried from
Intake, do not supply one yourself; move the card to Returned instead, and
say what is missing.

Release the card and move it to Review once your attachment stands.

columns.title: Review
columns.instructions:
You hold this card in a context nobody has primed either, and in
particular nobody has told you why Draft wrote what it wrote. Read the
workbench's own instructions, this column's instructions, and the card's
attachments in the order they were added, including Draft's; read nothing
about the conversation that produced it.

Judge Draft's attachment against the card and its earlier attachments
alone, and attach your findings. Move the card to Done where the draft
holds up. Where it needs revision the card's own attachments already
support, move it back to Draft instead; that return is bounded to three
passes, and a fourth is refused unless the operator carries it through
with an override. A draft that needs a fact, a decision, or the operator
the card does not carry goes to Returned rather than a guess.

columns.title: Done
columns.instructions:
The work this pipeline was built to produce is finished, and its
attachments carry the whole run in order. Nothing moves from here.

columns.title: Returned
columns.instructions:
A column needed a fact, a decision, or the operator this pipeline cannot
supply. File the reason and a pointer back to this card, with everything
it carries, on the workbench that owns the work, then close the card
here. Nobody reopens it; when what was missing is settled, a fresh card
starts the pipeline again.
